principles: A recovery hint must name the next valid command from the same authoritative blocker
A blocker must remain fail-closed and must not grant PRE_CERT or TEST authority
A TEST recovery must not imply a lifecycle rollback
drivers: done_prepare must not repeat an already refused heavy-validation command
certification-window and done_prepare must expose consistent next actions
regression must distinguish the direct finalize path from a DEV/REVIEW detour

options.name: Parse and propagate authoritative Next lines
pros: keeps the existing choke and blocker projection as the source of truth
works for done_prepare without duplicating blocker classification
cons: requires a narrow parser for structured refusal output

options.name: Hard-code the finalize command in done_prepare
cons: duplicates certification-window policy and can misroute other blockers

chosen: Parse and propagate authoritative Next lines
rationale: The choke already computes the blocker-specific command. Propagating that command avoids policy duplication while preserving the existing fail-closed gate; the certification helper should likewise render the projection command instead of overwriting it.

preMortem.scenario: A non-inventory PRE_CERT blocker is incorrectly routed to review_inventory_finalize
preMortem.trigger: parser matches any failure text without validating the blocker code or command
preMortem.consequence: operators skip required merge, coverage, or finding remediation
preMortem.mitigation: extract only the exact proof-or-stop command from the rendered Next line and otherwise retain the caller default

preMortem.scenario: A missing-window error loses the recovery command again
preMortem.trigger: refuseHeavyCertificationUnlessAdmitted replaces projection.nextCommand for all blocked states
preMortem.consequence: TEST repeats certification_window_status instead of finalizing inventory
preMortem.mitigation: use projection.nextCommand unless the window is admitted/running and heavy validation is the legitimate next action

preMortem.scenario: Regression passes only because it asserts text, not lifecycle safety
preMortem.trigger: test does not model TEST phase and attempted transition
preMortem.consequence: a future change can route through DEV/REVIEW unnoticed
preMortem.mitigation: assert the story remains TEST and the next command is finalize in the focused smoke
